name: cloudquest
description: Estudo para certificações Azure e AWS: fichas, aulas curtas, simulados e trilha de carreira.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:legacy
scripts.test:legacy: node scripts/build-test-bundle.mjs && node tests/test-logic.js && node tests/test-questoes.js && node tests/test-perimetro.js && node tests/test-dom.js && node tests/test-features.js && node tests/test-leitura.js
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/run-browser-tests.mjs tests/browser/check-layout.js tests/browser/check-a11y.js tests/browser/check-disabled.js tests/browser/check-weights.js tests/browser/check-motion.js tests/browser/check-share.js tests/browser/check-guia-rede.js tests/browser/check-questoes-rede.js tests/browser/check-videos.js tests/browser/check-revisao.js tests/browser/check-estude.js tests/browser/check-conta.js tests/browser/check-offline.js && node tests/browser/check-csp.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run size && npm run test:browser && npm run test:e2e
scripts.vercel-build: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run size
